content: NMF appears to provide more coherent topic on specific corpora. O'Callaghan et al. compared LDA with NMF and concluded that NMF performs better in corporas with specific and non-mainstream areas BIBREF21. Our findings align with this assessment and thus our comparison of topics is based on NMF.
